proposed_facts.reason: Canonical lines 15–37 declare the unsized callback array with three populated records and a null fourth record, followed by StageData. The replacement correctly limits conclusions to source declarations rather than compiled section placement or layout.

Canonical lines 39–45 establish the module-static pointer and three DynamicsDesc pointer fields. Lines 160–185 establish their ceiling/right-wall/left-wall associations. Static zero initialization is supported by C semantics; compiled small-data placement remains explicitly unproven.

Independently inspected all cited lines. Initialization assigns the cache at line 54. The lookup rejects -1 before querying, permits only joint 0, directly returns the three selected fields, and otherwise returns NULL. It does not locally mutate, allocate, copy, or validate the cache. External lifetime validity is correctly expressed as a precondition, not a proven guarantee.
